      <div id="content_area" data-container="content"><div id="content_start"></div>
        <div id="cc-matrix-1816220213"><div id="cc-m-7207269713" class="j-module n j-header "><h1 class="" id="cc-m-header-7207269713">KITESURFING ON RHODES</h1></div><div id="cc-m-7207269813" class="j-module n j-header "><h2 class="" id="cc-m-header-7207269813">Greece: 20.-27.06.2026</h2></div><div id="cc-m-7207269913" class="j-module n j-text "><p class="MsoNormal">
    Rhodes did it again – and this time, it felt even more special. Between the amazing wind, endless sunshine and the warm hospitality of the Airriders Kite Pro-Center, the spot proved once more why
    it’s such a perfect playground for kiters of every level. Whether someone was getting up on the board or refining advanced tricks, there was space – and support – for exactly where they were.
</p>
<p class="MsoNormal">
    That’s what made this retreat stand out: nobody was left behind and nobody held back. What mattered was the energy everyone brought to the water and to each other.
</p>
<p class="MsoNormal">
</p>
<p class="MsoNormal">
    Off the water, the group turned into something bigger than a bunch of kiters on vacation. Dinners ran long, laughter got louder, and stories were swapped freely – the kind of easy closeness that
    usually takes a lot of time to build happened in just a few days. Watching someone land their first jump, or finally ride upwind with confidence became a shared celebration, not just a personal
    milestone.
</p>
<p class="MsoNormal">
</p>
<p class="MsoNormal">
    By the end of the week, the real takeaway wasn’t the kiting itself – it was the sense of belonging that had quietly formed. A group of women, all at different points in their journey, who left as
    friends.
</p>
<p class="MsoNormal">
</p>
<p class="MsoNormal">
    Rhodes, thank you for the wind, the sun, and most of all, for bringing us together once again…
</p></div><div id="cc-m-7207270013" class="j-module n j-spacing ">
    <div class="cc-m-spacer" style="height: 5px;">
